name: ClinicalBench
intro: ClinicalBench是基于MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV真实临床数据的预测建模评测基准，全面比较通用和医疗大型语言模型与传统机器学习模型在临床预测任务上的表现，涵盖死亡率预测、再入院预测等关键任务。
org: Illinois Institute of Technology, Harvard Medical School, Weill Cornell Medicine
build_method: MIMIC-III/IV首次就诊队列, 分层划分, 仅训练集欠采样, 临床代码转文本
metric: Macro F1, F1, AUROC, 95%置信区间
eval_feature: LLM与传统ML模型头对头比较，基于真实临床数据
scale: 2个数据库, 3个任务, 22个LLM, 11个传统ML模型
build_method_en: MIMIC-III/IV first-visit cohorts, stratified splits, training-only under-sampling, and clinical code-to-text conversion
eval_feature_en: Head-to-head comparison between LLM and traditional ML models, based on real clinical data
intro_en: ClinicalBench is a predictive modeling benchmark based on real clinical data from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV. It comprehensively compares the performance of general and medical large language models with traditional machine learning models on clinical prediction tasks, including key tasks such as mortality prediction and readmission prediction.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.06469. The paper defines ClinicalBench around three clinical prediction tasks: length-of-stay, mortality, and readmission prediction. It adopts MIMIC-III v1.4 and MIMIC-IV v2.2, keeps first-time visits, removes patients under 18 and records with missing values, then uses stratified train/validation/test splits. Because the training labels are imbalanced, only the training set is under-sampled while validation and test remain unchanged. Clinical codes for diagnoses, procedures, medications, and drugs are converted to text descriptions for LLM input. The benchmark compares traditional ML models and general/medical LLMs under direct prompting, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning strategies, then reports Macro F1, F1, AUROC, confusion matrices, and loss curves.
